description: This Java class implements a DocumentationProvider for Android XML files within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin, providing documentation generation and lookup functionalities for Android resource references and attributes.

classes.name: MyDocElement
classes.description: A fake PSI element representing documentation text for display purposes.

classes.name: MyResourceElement
classes.description: A fake PSI element representing a resource reference for documentation purposes.

methods.name: getQuickNavigateInfo
methods.description: Returns quick navigation info for resource elements.

methods.name: getUrlFor
methods.description: Returns URL list for documentation, not implemented.

methods.name: generateDoc
methods.description: Generates documentation string for a given PSI element, handling resource references and attribute documentation.

methods.name: getResourceDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for resource URLs or resource file definitions.

methods.name: generateDocForXmlAttribute
methods.description: Creates HTML documentation for an attribute definition.

methods.name: findAttributeDefinition
methods.description: Finds attribute definition within the current XML context.

methods.name: findAttributeDefinitionGlobally
methods.description: Finds attribute definition globally in resource manager.

methods.name: generateDoc
methods.description: Overloaded method to generate documentation from resource type and name or from ResourceUrl.

methods.name: getDocumentationElementForLookupItem
methods.description: Provides PSI element for lookup item documentation.
